data.name: Section1BodyEn
data.value: In compliance with the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA) of Malaysia, MAES24 is committed to protecting your personal data and ensuring your privacy is respected.

data.name: Section1BodyMs
data.value: Berdasarkan Akta Perlindungan Data Peribadi 2010 (PDPA) Malaysia, MAES24 komited melindungi data peribadi anda dan memastikan privasi anda dihormati.

data.name: Section2BodyEn
data.value: We collect personal identifiers including your Full Name, IC Number, Phone Number, Residential Address, and residency verification documents during registration.

data.name: Section2BodyMs
data.value: Kami mengumpul butiran peribadi termasuk Nama Penuh, Nombor IC, Nombor Telefon, Alamat Kediaman, dan dokumen pengesahan semasa pendaftaran.

data.name: Section3BodyEn
data.value: Your information is used strictly for mosque membership verification, community administration, and internal records managed by authorized committee members.

data.name: Section3BodyMs
data.value: Maklumat anda digunakan khusus untuk pengesahan keahlian masjid, pentadbiran komuniti, dan rekod dalaman oleh Ahli Jawatankuasa yang sah.

data.name: Section4BodyEn
data.value: All data is securely stored in cloud infrastructure and encrypted databases with strict role-based access control preventing unauthorized exposure.

data.name: Section4BodyMs
data.value: Semua data disimpan dengan selamat di infrastruktur awan dan pangkalan data tersulit dengan kawalan akses ketat.
